notes: Strip f (x 9000-10748) plus margin to x 8700. Woolper is printed 'WOOLPER ... STREET' on this plate (not Avenue); it jogs about 65 px south at Vine (west part centre y~100, east stub centre y~168), pick placed between. Vine Street makes the big bend: from the north edge it curves SSW to about (8650,2300) [outside this strip], then runs east as the E-W leg from the Ruther junction at (8760,2710), angles SE at (9425,2800), curves south at (10260-10585, 3765-4015), runs south along x~10585 to Nixon. The street from the Vine junction at (8760,2710) south to Jefferson is printed 'AVE.' on its N-S part and 'RUTHER' on its SW part; treated as one street Ruther Avenue. An unnamed 20 ft alley runs from Vine (9118,2752) SSE to the head of Marmet Street (9535,3468) and is written '?'. It meets Marmet end to end: the alley's centreline (slope about 0.5 px x per px y) lies about 35 px west of Marmet's (slope about 0.24) where they join, and the width changes from 20 ft to 40 ft. The large spaced letters L-O-C-?-A... that cross it diagonally are a subdivision name, not the alley's name. Bear Avenue: the E-W leg is printed 'BEAR', the NE leg to Vine is printed 'AVE.' followed by a 'C' that may be a large subdivision letter (could be read 'Ave. C'); treated as one street Bear Avenue with a corner bend at (9885,3928). Bishop Street: the curving street from Vine (west of strip) down x~8750, curving east to x~9090, south to Loretta, then SW across Jefferson to the straight N-S Bishop at x~8887 (label BISHOP on both parts). Bishop crosses Jefferson with only a ~10 px offset between its two arms. East-side stubs of Vine with no printed name: y 1265 (printed 'M...', perhaps Mitchell Avenue), y 4017 (at the Vine bend, streetcar tracks turn into it), y 4543. Stub south of West Nixon at x 9262 printed '...IAL' (name cut). Nixon is 'W. NIXON' west of Vine and 'E. NIXON ST.' east of Vine; both names recorded at the Vine crossing. Big spaced labels LEWIS, SHIELDS, STIRLINGS, HINMAN'S, McMILLAN'S, ERKENBRECHER, JACOB ELSER'S, McKELS are subdivision names, not streets. Two unnamed 20 ft alleys in McMillan's subdivision (x 10050 and 10300, y 4290-4640) touch no street. Hosea Avenue, Marion Avenue and Loretta Street junctions with Bishop lie in the left margin (x 8700-9100). Woolper: this plate prints 'WOOLPER' then 'STREET' along the top edge (INSTRUCTIONS22 lists Woolper Street); I recorded it as Woolper Street, so check this against the other strips. Doubtful name: the curving street through the left margin (x 8700-9100, y 2800-4900) is printed BISHOP on its NW leg and BISHOP ST. on the straight south leg below Jefferson, but spaced letters A-V-E (and S-T near y 4110) are also printed along its curving middle part. I treated the whole street as Bishop Street, but the middle part may carry a second name ending in 'Ave.'.
